description: Free. Creates a scannable QR code from a website URL, such as a restaurant menu, event page, business website or product link, with no account or API key required. Returns the PNG image, download links on QRCodeDinosaur.com for the PNG (imageUrl) and SVG (svgUrl), and the SVG markup when format is "svg". Owners can create a shareable page from their portfolio. Codes are plain by default and support an optional green dino mascot in the center. Requires a destination URL; supports public HTTP/HTTPS links, not Wi-Fi credentials, contact cards, arbitrary text or decoding an existing QR image. Every code encodes a scan link (scanUrl) on QRCodeDinosaur.com that counts scans and forwards to the URL, so its destination can be changed later by an owner with Pro without reprinting. Signed in or with an API key, the code belongs to that account. Otherwise the result includes a claimUrl, valid for 30 days, that adds the code to the QR codes of whoever opens it on QRCodeDinosaur.com. Unsafe links and links to private or internal hosts are refused with an error that names the reason.

format.description: Hosted PNG and SVG links are always returned. "svg" also returns the SVG markup.

style.description: Plain by default. "green-dino" adds the green dinosaur mascot to the code.

url.description: Destination website URL to encode, e.g. https://example.com/menu. Required; https:// is added if no scheme is given.
